name: aws-key
means: an AWS access key

name: private-key
means: a private key

name: bearer-token
means: a bearer token

name: basic-auth
means: a basic auth header, which holds a username and password

name: jwt
means: a signed token

name: github-token
means: a GitHub token

name: key-prefix
means: an API key from a known service (Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack or Google)

name: password-assign
means: a password or key written next to its name

name: password-prose
means: a password or key written out in a sentence

name: jdbc
means: a database connection string

name: oracle-connect
means: an Oracle connect string, with or without a port

name: sin-ssn
means: a SIN or SSN

name: card
means: something shaped like a card number

name: email
means: an email address

name: phone
means: a phone number

name: health
means: health, or the reason someone is away: never keep it, and remove the whole sentence before sending

name: money
means: a dollar amount, including US$, CA$, USD and CAD

name: ipv4
means: an IP address. A line about versions or patches is skipped, because a version number looks the same

name: company-suffix
means: a company name

name: tenant
means: a cloud tenant id

name: userpath
means: a path with a username in it

name: internal-host
means: an internal host name or URL (.internal, .corp, .local, .lan, .intranet, or an intranet. site)

name: private-ip
means: a private network address (RFC 1918), which names a machine inside an organisation

name: customer-number
means: a customer, account, contract or invoice number

name: opinion-line
means: someone's own assessment of a person, which must say whose view it is
